title: A session issued after code exchange grants access to a protected route
asA: operator holding a project session cookie issued by the flow controller
iWant: a subsequent request to a project route wired behind the session-verify middleware to see the resolved Principal
soThat: the project reasons about my identity without a fresh sign-in

acceptanceCriteria.description: A request to a protected route carrying a valid session cookie sees a resolved Principal on the request.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the session cookie from US-10101 and a project route wired behind the session-verify middleware from TAC-1103
acceptanceCriteria.then: the middleware attaches `request.auth` carrying `principalId`, `provider`, `email` (if the provider returned one), `roles` (empty array by default), and `organisationIds` (empty array by default); `principalId` is a stable string derived from `{ provider.id, sub }` (OIDC) or `{ provider.id, userinfo.id }` (oauth2-only)

acceptanceCriteria.description: A request to a protected route without a session cookie, or with an invalidated handle, is refused before the route handler runs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project route wired behind the session-verify middleware
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request is dispatched with no session cookie, then with a cookie whose value has been tampered by a single byte
acceptanceCriteria.then: the middleware treats each request as unauthenticated; the route handler is not invoked; the response is a 4xx (or a redirect to the sign-in route, per the wiring shim's declared class); no `request.auth` is attached in either case

acceptanceCriteria.description: The session-bridge does not expose provider tokens on `request.auth`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the session cookie from US-10101 and a protected route
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request is dispatched and the resolved `request.auth` object is inspected for keys
acceptanceCriteria.then: the object contains only the fields named in AC-10106-1; no `accessToken`, `idToken`, `refreshToken`, or provider-raw-claims field is exposed
